snippet.title: A SYMMETRIC ESCAPE - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on Steam! 🔁🧩🔃 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278300/A_Symmetric_Escape/

Explore and solve your way through the gloomy halls in which you find yourself stuck. Thinking symmetrically will be key! Isolated and environmental puzzles feature in this (almost) pure puzzle experience.

#indiegame #indiedev #godotengine #godot #puzzlegame #games #walkingsimulator
